name: trackyourtime-raycast
title: Track Your Time
description: Start, stop and edit Track Your Time entries, with a live timer in the macOS menu bar.
author: trebeljahr

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Timer Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: Track Your Time
commands.description: Show the running timer in the macOS menu bar, with stop, edit and recent work in its menu.

preferences.name: titleMode
preferences.title: Menu Bar Title
preferences.description: What the menu bar shows while a timer runs.

preferences.name: idleTitle
preferences.title: When No Timer Runs
preferences.description: What the menu bar shows while no timer runs.

preferences.name: tickSeconds
preferences.title: Clock
preferences.label: Count seconds while a timer runs
preferences.description: On keeps the command loaded so the clock moves every second. Off updates the clock once a minute.

preferences.name: hideWhenIdle
preferences.title: Idle
preferences.label: Hide the menu bar item when no timer runs
preferences.description: The item comes back when a timer starts.

commands.name: toggle-timer
commands.title: Start / Stop Timer
commands.subtitle: Track Your Time
commands.description: Stop the running timer, or resume your latest entry from the past 7 days. Assign a hotkey to it.

commands.name: timer
commands.title: Timer
commands.subtitle: Track Your Time
commands.description: Start or stop a timer from a form, a favorite or recent work.

commands.name: entries
commands.title: Show All Time
commands.subtitle: Track Your Time
commands.description: Browse the last 14 days of entries, then continue, edit or delete them.

commands.name: open-dashboard
commands.title: Open Dashboard
commands.subtitle: Track Your Time
commands.description: Open the web app for reports, invoices and catalog editing.

preferences.name: apiUrl
preferences.title: API URL
preferences.description: Address of your Track Your Time server, for example https://api.example.com. Leave empty for the hosted server.

preferences.name: webUrl
preferences.title: Web App URL
preferences.description: Address of the matching web app, where you approve sign-in. Leave empty for the hosted web app.

scripts.publish: node -e "console.error(\"Not from the monorepo. Run pnpm export:raycast, then publish from the exported directory.\"); process.exit(1)"
scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "console.error(\"This is a Raycast extension, not an npm package.\"); process.exit(1)"
